name: 190-bottom-side-land-joins-bottom-copper
why: The geometry of 040 and 050 with BOTH the land and the run moved to the back of the board. The 0.5/0.25mm offsets are the same ones 040 derives against the 0.84mm half-extent, so the end is on the copper. Completing that pair matters because a bottom-mounted part's land is the one whose side is DERIVED (the footprint states F.Cu; the placement flips it): 040 says a top land joins top copper, 050 says it does not join bottom copper, and only this case fails if a bottom land is left reading as top.
